yaaw-orchestrator.description: Continue or recover a YAAW project by reconstructing reality and autonomously dispatching the next safe workflow.

yaaw-prd.description: Drive product definition through Orchestrator while preserving prerequisite and downstream lifecycle safety.

yaaw-revise-prd.description: Request an accepted product-intent revision through Orchestrator and propagate downstream invalidation safely.

yaaw-refine-prd.description: Request product-document clarity refinement through Orchestrator without changing accepted product meaning.

yaaw-planner.description: Drive engineering discovery and planning through Orchestrator, resolving any upstream prerequisites first.

yaaw-planning-review.description: Request a fresh engineering-readiness assessment through Orchestrator after required planning prerequisites are satisfied.

yaaw-create-spec.description: Request specification creation through Orchestrator; unresolved product or engineering prerequisites are completed first.

yaaw-create-ticket.description: Request bounded implementation-ticket creation through Orchestrator after a current accepted spec exists.

yaaw-create-tickets.description: Request dependency-aware implementation tickets through Orchestrator after all planning prerequisites are satisfied.

yaaw-implement.description: Request implementation through Orchestrator; product, engineering, spec, and ticket prerequisites are resolved before code changes.

yaaw-repair.description: Request repair through Orchestrator without bypassing ticket state, review findings, or upstream contract validity.

yaaw-review.description: Request independent review through Orchestrator; missing implementation prerequisites are completed before review can run.
